Items before: orange juice (~200 ml, ~90 kcal), salad with dressing on the side (salad ~60 kcal, dressing bottle ~ balsamic, maybe 50 kcal), braised beef in small bowl (~150 g, ~250 kcal), egg/potato casserole (~150 g, ~220 kcal), ravioli with sauce (~200 g, ~300 kcal). A cone-shaped item is likely a wrapped utensil.

After: the juice is gone, so all 90 kcal was eaten. The salad is mostly left, so about 25% was eaten, ~15 kcal. The dressing is partly used, ~20 kcal. The casserole bowl is empty, so ~220 kcal. The ravioli is eaten, leaving two pieces of beef (it seems the beef was moved onto the ravioli bowl), so ~300 kcal. The beef bowl now has three pieces left on the plate, plus two in the ravioli bowl, so it looks like the beef was mostly left. Beef eaten is perhaps 30%, ~75 kcal. A yogurt container appears in the second photo, perhaps a dessert that came with the tray; it's unclear, so I'll ignore it.

Total: 90 + 15 + 20 + 220 + 300 + 75 = 720 kcal.

Mass: juice 200 + salad 20 + dressing 15 + casserole 150 + ravioli 200 + beef 45 = 630 g.
